newsitem.title: USA: United Dominion acquires SPIG Group.
newsitem.headline: United Dominion acquires SPIG Group.

text.p: United Dominion Industries Ltd, manufacturer of diversified engineered products, said Monday it has acquired the Italian SPIG Group, a privately owned group of companies serving Europe's cooling tower and related components markets.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
The SPIG Group consists of two principal businesses and related international subsidiaries which have combined annual sales of approximately $32 million, United Dominion said.

SPIG SpA, Italy's leading cooling tower company, will become part of United Dominion's Marley Cooling Tower unit, substantially expanding Marley's presence in Europe. With more than 40 percent of its sales outside Italy, SPIG primarily provides wet cooling towers for industrial power applications.

COFIMCO, a manufacturer of aluminum fan assemblies and fiberglass components for wet and dry cooling towers and industrial ventilation applications, will become a stand-alone United Dominion business. COFIMCO SpA has a manufacturing facility near Stresa in Northern Italy. -- New York
